mfg: Make waist ties: fold in half, enclose raw edges, bag out and edgestitch the long edge
Make neck strap: bag out one end
Set neck strap to the right-hand side as worn of the bib. Set bib facing
Stitch down bib facing to form 5 cm topstitch of the front bib
Fold towel loop in half. Set towel loop 7.5 cm from the cut edge side seam. Double turn armholes and topstitch 6 mm. Stitch down towel loop
Set ties to finish to the top of the side seam
Double turn side seams and hem and topstitch 12 mm
Double stitch waist tie to secure at the side seam
Set pocket hem: double turn and topstitch 2 cm
Set pocket to the front centrally within the width of the front and 29.5 cm up from the finished hem
Edgestitch pocket in position. Triangle tack at the top of the pocket mouth to secure
Set button to the left side of the bib as worn, 2 cm from the armhole edge of the bib and centrally within the depth of the bib facing stitching. Thread to match the button
fin: Set buckle. Check, trim, press and fold
Tissue in Oliver Harvey tissue, description label bottom right-hand corner, put in a plastic bag (NOT in a tin)
